feeds.title: Mongabay
feeds.description: Mongabay is a nonprofit environmental science and conservation news platform that produces original reporting in several languages. Our main beats are forests, wildlife, oceans, and the conservation sector. Read news and inspirational articles in our blog.

feeds.title: THE WILDLIFE SOCIETY
feeds.description: The main aim of The Wildlife Society is to sustain a healthy wildlife population and habitats for the generation to come. Get more articles related to wildlife science, management and conservation by following this blog.

feeds.title: Asiatic Lion and Gir Forest
feeds.description: Asiatic Lion Protection Society (ALPS) founded in the year 2006, is an NGO working mainly for conservation of Asiatic Lion in Gir forest and in Indian Zoos. Discover the latest updates by following our feed.

feeds.title: David Shepherd Wildlife Foundation
feeds.description: The David Shepherd Wildlife Foundation is a highly effective wildlife conservation charity funding key projects across Africa and Asia. Catch up with latest wildlife conservation news and the events that help support our work to protect some of the world's most endangered animals.

feeds.title: Non-Stop Birding
feeds.description: This blog is about the birds and wildlife that I encounter day to day and also covers wildlife trips through the year and conservation issues that we face. Follow to keep up with the latest updates.

feeds.title: Biosphere Expeditions Blog
feeds.description: Biosphere Expeditions is a non-profit citizen science wildlife conservation expeditions. Follow this blog for more information related to wildlife conservation.

feeds.title: World Wildlife Fund Stories
feeds.description: Read the Latest conservation stories from WWF. For 60 years, WWF has worked to help people and nature thrive. As the world's leading conservation organization, WWF works in nearly 100 countries. At every level, we collaborate with people around the world to develop and deliver innovative solutions that protect communities, wildlife, and the places in which they live.

feeds.title: Louisiana Wildlife Federation Blog
feeds.description: The voice of Louisiana's wildlife and natural resources since 1940. LWF represents a broad constituency of conservationists including hunters, anglers, campers, birders, boaters, and other outdoor enthusiasts who believe in constructive conservation and protection of our state's natural resources and the quality of the environment. Explore our blog for the latest news and updates, wild conservation, animal conservation and more!

feeds.title: National Wildlife Refuge Association
feeds.description: National Wildlife Refuge Association aims to conserve American wildlife for future generations by protecting, enhancing and expanding the National Wildlife Refuge System and the wildlife habitats beyond its boundaries that secure its ecological integrity. Keep up to date with the latest wildlife refuge news and updates.

feeds.title: Born Free USA
feeds.description: Read the latest news as we work to ensure that all wild animals, whether living in captivity or in the wild, are treated with compassion and respect. We work to ensure that all wild animals, whether living in captivity or in the wild, are treated with compassion and respect and are able to live their lives according to their needs. Not only does our conservation work occur in communities, classrooms, courtrooms, and the halls of Congress, we also operate one of the largest primate sanctuaries in the U.S.

feeds.title: Conservation Northwest
feeds.description: Get the latest on our work protecting, connecting and restoring wildlife and wildlands in our News Updates. These articles include work updates, statements, reports, WILD NW Action Alerts, and more. Founded in Bellingham, Washington in 1989, we're your voice for conserving local wildlands and wildlife. We protect, connect and restore wildlands and wildlife from the Washington Coast to the British Columbia Rockies.

feeds.title: Conservation Mag » Wildlife
feeds.description: Conversation magazine featuring nature conservation, wildlife and ecotourism. We are a magazine focused on the importance of wildlife and educating people about the crucial role that animals and nature have in our lives. Our focus is to provide a voice for the voiceless, while also making it easy for everyone to learn more about the environment, outdoor lifestyle, wildlife photography, nature reserves, wildlife conservation and African Safari travel.

feeds.title: EDGE of Existence Blog
feeds.description: The EDGE of Existence program highlights and protects some of the most unique species on the planet, which are on the verge of extinction. These weird and wonderful species are Evolutionarily Distinct and Globally Endangered. Representing a unique and irreplaceable part of our world's biodiversity, many EDGE species have been overlooked by conservationists - until now. Explore our conservation work around the world, from Fellows to Projects to Expeditions, to learn more about these amazing species.

feeds.title: National Wildlife Federation Blog
feeds.description: As America's largest non-profit conservation organization, the National Wildlife Federation works closely with those who span the social and political spectrum, but who are connected by a common commitment to conservation. Our ability to meet the needs of wildlife is inextricably linked to the over 6 million amazing individuals, groups, organizations and corporations we call our supporters. Learn more about our project, work, wildlife, endangered species and more!

feeds.title: Alachua Conservation Trust Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Alachua Conservation Trust (ACT) is to protect the natural, historic, scenic and recreational resources in and around North Central Florida. ACT protects land through purchase, donation, and conservation easements in 16 counties. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates along with information on our work in the blog.

feeds.title: Wildlife Biology Blog
feeds.description: Wildlife Biology is a high-quality scientific forum directing concise and up-to-date information to scientists, administrators, wildlife managers and conservationists. While Wildlife Biology primarily publishes ecological papers, contributions to the human dimensions of wildlife management are also welcome. Our concept of 'wildlife' mainly includes mammal and bird species, but studies on other species or phenomena relevant to wildlife management are also of great interest.

feeds.title: Think Wild Blog
feeds.description: The Think Wild Blog aims to help you consider wildlife in your day-to-day choices and take actions to promote native wildlife success. We see 'Think Wild' as a shared ethos in our High Desert community and work to help Central Oregonians deepen their understanding of wildlife as we share our lands and care for and stewarding these lands (our backyards) for wildlife, as population pressures grow. Think Wild's mission is to inspire the high desert community to care for and protect native wildlife through education, conservation, and rescue/rehabilitation.

feeds.title: Conservation International Blog
feeds.description: Exploring the vital connections between nature's well-being and our own. Since 1987, Conservation International has worked to spotlight and secure the critical benefits that nature provides to humanity. Combining fieldwork with innovations in science, policy and finance, we've helped protect more than 6 million square kilometers (2.3 million square miles) of land and sea across more than 70 countries.

feeds.title: Global Wildlife Conservation
feeds.description: The Global Wildlife Conservation blog has everything you need to learn, explore, and participate in the conservation of species and spaces. Get more information about wildlife conservation by following this feed.

feeds.title: Kate on Conservation Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: All content featured on Kate on Conservation blog: a wildlife blog that highlights important issues faced by our planet's wild and domestic animal species.

feeds.title: Dr. Chandrima Debi's Blog
feeds.description: Through this blog I share my observations and experiences with nature and environment through writings, poetry, and photography. Instilling love for mother nature and forests around us and aid towards the protection and conservation of biodiversity, wildlife and the values associated.

feeds.title: Community Markets for Conservation Blog
feeds.description: COMACO is a social enterprise that supports wildlife conservation and small-scale farmers in Eastern Zambia. Get more information about wildlife conservation by following this feed.

feeds.title: Wild Things
feeds.description: Wild Things is the blog of the Wildlife Conservation Society Archives. The WCS Archives holds the things, the records, artwork, ephemera that document WCS's long history of saving wildlife and wild places. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Sam Veasna Center Blog
feeds.description: Sam Veasna Center is a Non-Profit Organization. We believe that it is necessary to provide alternative livelihoods in order to achieve sustainable conservation. Follow for more updates.

feeds.title: Being Wild Jackson Hole Blog
feeds.description: We believe in keeping Jackson Hole wild to protect our ecosystem for future generations to enjoy. Learn more on our conservation blog at Being Wild Jackson Hole. Our Wildlife Being Wild Jackson Hole intends to deepen stewardship ethics that will engender lifelong curiosity by engaging visitors with wildlife and conservation content truly unique to this place.

feeds.title: Conservation Action Trust
feeds.description: The Conservation Action Trust works for the protection of threatened species by reporting on conservation and environmental issues affecting these species. Follow this blog for regular updates.

feeds.title: Wildlife Conservation Trust - Blog
feeds.description: Wildlife Conservation Trust has adopted a 360° approach to conservation by focusing equally on wildlife protection and community development. Follow to get regular updates from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Zoo New England Blog
feeds.description: Here, we share some of the amazing work going on 'beyond the zoo' at a variety of field sites around New England. Expect tales from the field, interesting nature facts, and the occasional guest post from one of our local - or international! - community partners. Zoo New England's mission is to inspire people to protect and sustain the natural world for future generations by creating fun and engaging experiences that integrate wildlife and conservation programs, research, and education.

feeds.title: Saevus
feeds.description: Saevus is a premium magazine & web portal, showcasing the best of Photography, Travel, Nature, bio-diversity & wildlife of India and the world. Follow this for articles on nature and wildlife conservation.

feeds.title: African Conservation Experience Blog
feeds.description: Support animal conservation in Africa through ethical wildlife volunteering, conservation travel also responsible for wildlife experiences. Follow our blog where we will share useful information about conservation travel and keeping you up to date with all things ACE!

feeds.title: WildlifeACT Blog
feeds.description: Volunteer and experience real wildlife conservation in Africa. Our blog shares news updates around the endangered wildlife species we work with and also highlights the wildlife volunteering experience. We are saving Africa's endangered wildlife through informed, impact-driven projects, thereby enabling broad-scale biodiversity conservation
